steps.name: Complete new-user onboarding for goal: Boost overall health
Select iOS onboarding goal: Boost overall health
Close iOS onboarding paywalls and optional popups
Verify Today program matches onboarding: OH
Read the active program shown on Today
Normalize Coach session for the next test
Close PDF guide upsell if it is displayed
Close notification prompt if it is displayed
Close Connect Email prompt if it is displayed
Close Kegel exercise flow if it is already open
Confirm logout if confirmation dialog appears
